purpose: Explicit exemptions for parent-code references into the vendored openclaw_runtime tree that cannot resolve in a source checkout, required by issue #93 ("existence-checked or explicitly exempted"). Every entry needs a non-empty reason; the guard fails closed on any dangling reference that is not listed here.
howToAdd: Add { file, target, reason } where target may use '*' wildcards. Prefer fixing the reference. A stale entry (one that no longer matches any reference) is reported as INFO and never fails the check.

entries.reason: Generated BENCHMARK_SCRIPT text, piped to `tsx -` with cwd = repo root, so its `./openclaw_runtime/...` specifier resolves against the repo root rather than against scripts/. Verified by reading the spawn call (cwd: ROOT, input: BENCHMARK_SCRIPT).
Build output, produced by `pnpm run build:runtime`; a source checkout legitimately has no dist/ tree. The script hashes the file at run time and fails on its own when the build is missing.

PREREQUISITE_PATHS is the expected file set of the historical diff PREREQUISITE_DIFF_BASE..PREREQUISITE_COMMIT (c860c12f4), compared against `git diff --name-only` for that range, not against the working tree. The path existed in that range and was later renamed; existence must be judged against the pinned commit. The list length is also pinned (38), so it must not be edited to silence this guard.
